parsed.note_claim: Europeans have been building bathhouses/steam baths for over 1500 years, long before the Moors colonized Europe.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Iron Age saunas, unique to the Castro Culture of northwestern Iberia, have puzzled archaeologists since the nineteenth century. Initially interpreted as kilns, crematoriums, or ovens, their function has since been established as bathing structures
parsed.reason: The article confirms Iron Age Europeans (1100 BC-AD 100) constructed and used bathing structures, which predates the Moorish arrival in the 8th century AD.
